purpose: Seed ledger for joint experimental-constraint reconstruction. Every entry must be verified against the primary source before use in inference.

primary_source.citation: Peña-Münzenmayer et al., J Biol Chem 2015

whole_gland_secretion.AE4_KO_timecourse: Comparable to WT for initial 2-3 min, then sustained reduction after approximately 3 min.
whole_gland_secretion.AE2_KO: Essentially identical secretion kinetics and total output to strain-matched control; n=6 each. Verify/digitize source figure if quantitative time-course constraints are used.

isolated_NKCC1.protocol: HCO3-free; 30 uM ethoxyzolamide; 50 uM T16Ainh-A01; Cl depletion followed by readdition.
isolated_NKCC1.genotype_result: No statistically detectable difference in NKCC1-dependent initial Cl uptake among control, AE4 KO and AE2 KO under this assay.
isolated_NKCC1.constraint_rule: Do not translate non-significance into exact equality or an invented numerical tolerance. Simulate the assay protocol separately.

NHE_assay.genotype_result: No statistically detectable difference in stimulation-induced NHE-mediated alkalinisation among control, AE4 KO and AE2 KO.
NHE_assay.EIPA: 10 uM EIPA reverses the stimulated alkalinisation to acidification; n=7.
NHE_assay.constraint_rule: A reconstruction must not obtain AE4-KO rescue failure by strongly suppressing NHE activity.

isolated_HCO3_dependent_exchanger.protocol_note: NKCC1 and Tmem16A inhibited; verify exact inhibitor concentrations and solution composition from source before implementation.

secondary_mechanistic_sources.citation: Peña-Münzenmayer et al., J Gen Physiol 2016
facts_to_verify: Na EC50 approximately 49 mM with Hill coefficient approximately 2.0
K EC50 approximately 62 mM with Hill coefficient approximately 1.8
both Na and K support/participate in AE4 transport
constitutively active PKA increases AE4 activity

secondary_mechanistic_sources.citation: Evans et al., J Biol Chem 2000
facts_to_verify: NKCC1 knockout reduces muscarinic-stimulated saliva by more than 60% in mouse parotid

secondary_mechanistic_sources.citation: Park et al., J Biol Chem 2001
facts_to_verify: NHE1 knockout removes more than 95% of acinar Na/H exchange

nonnegotiable_rules: Use one shared scientific parameter vector across genotypes and protocols.
Give each established knockout its own relaxed resting state; do not use a shared WT initial state as the primary comparator.
Genotype changes only the experimentally deleted transporter; do not fit genotype-specific capacity multipliers.
Protocol changes only documented agonists, extracellular solution, inhibitors and source-supported signalling inputs.
Do not equate a non-significant difference with exact equality.
Do not invent numerical tolerances such as 5% or 10%.
Whole-gland outputs must be compared via ratios and time-course shape unless an acinus-to-gland scale is independently justified.
SPQ fluorescence observables require an explicit observation operator or a documented normalized comparison; do not identify them directly with fmol/s transporter flux.
Do not tune solely to the approximately 35% saliva endpoint.
Do not perform a Cartesian-product sweep or mechanism-family search.

If the inherited AE4 law lacks beta-adrenergic/cAMP/PKA activation, treat the smallest AE4-specific activation mechanism as the first documented equation correction, and fit it to isolated exchanger data rather than secretion.
After that, allow at most one additional equation-level correction, only if a specific residual pattern and independent evidence require it.
